newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Sept Btp sets new high, bund spread new low.
newsitem.headline: Italy Sept Btp sets new high, bund spread new low.

text.p: The Italian Btp September future on Liffe touched a new all-time high on Tuesday morning, hitting 133.78 and then rising further to 133.92 with the spread over the 10-year benchmark bund narrowing to a new low of 117 basis points.
Traders cited continuing optimism over European monetary union convergence boosting market sentiment.
